newsitem.title: USA: Florida teen shot playing by St.Patrick's day floats.
newsitem.headline: Florida teen shot playing by St.Patrick's day floats.

text.p: A 76-year-old builder shot and killed a Florida teenager who was exploring a warehouse where St. Patrick's Day floats were being decorated, police said on Monday.
The man, Stanley Quaggin, is now in custody charged with second degree murder.
The victim, 14-year-old Eric Brooks, was killed by a gunshot to his chest. A 10-year-old boy with him was not wounded, sheriff's spokesman Gary Davidson said.
The incident occurred on Sunday in DeLand, about 30 miles (48 km) east of Orlando.
Quaggin apparently lived in the industrial warehouse where he built floats for many parades, authorities said.
The two boys wandered over to Quaggin's property while the 10-year-old's father was doing business at a neighbouring warehouse.
DeLand resident Sarah Carter said Quaggin has used a handgun to warn people off his unfenced property in the past.
She and others have complained to local authorities about the property.

"That stuff might look good in a parade, but it's junk the rest of the time, scattered all of the place," she said. "It's nothing but an attractive nuisance and there's no wonder kids would go looking through there."
